# opnsense_nginx_ip_acl (Data Source)

nginx IP access lists (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Access ▸ IP ACLs**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACL.

### Read-Only

- `default_action` (String) Action for clients matching no entry.
- `description` (String) Name of the ACL.
- `entries` (Attributes List) ACL entries, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `allow` or `deny`.
- `network` (String) Address or network.
